lines.say: a hormone the brain makes in the dark that times the body clock
in sleep disorders, asleep about 7 minutes sooner and 8 minutes longer (19 trials)
asleep about 34 minutes earlier in delayed sleep phase disorder (one trial)
may ease jet lag, mainly after eastward flights (low-quality evidence)
less anxiety before surgery than with placebo (review of trials)
accidental swallowing by young children: about 11,000 emergency visits in 4 years
next-day drowsiness, especially in older adults; also headache and dizziness

ask: Is my sleep problem the kind melatonin may help, such as jet lag or a delayed sleep schedule, or would CBT for insomnia be better?
